result.text: The little firefly went back upstream with its old creek postcard tucked away at home. A twig had caught under a stone lip; instead of waiting at the familiar viewing spot, it tried the other bank. From there, the water's narrow exit was finally visible. You have walked after dinner for four days, and today you wrote down the differences between two observations of a twig turning beside a creek. The firefly cannot see those notes, but it has a small observation of its own to send: a postcard sketch of the hidden opening. Beside the sketch it writes, ‘I found a way to see the bend from here.’ It leaves the twig in the current and takes the longer route home.
result.connection: Uses the four after-dinner walks and today's two recorded observations exactly; the other-bank exploration belongs to the pet's fictional world.
